context:
Goal: Home's open pull requests match what you still want.

Based on (notes): the consultant relayed this at 23:19 CST Nov 15; I did not read the pull request.

ref: Home #684 (docs recording the 2026-11-11 wish to take home builds local)
reply: Runner 11 read Home #684 at 13:36 CST by GitHub (draft, head 55bf79ee2506, docs only, 3 files, +55 lines). Title: "Handoffs for the move from cloud to a local session"; body: "so a local session can resume the home build (owner, 2026-11-11 19:27 CST)". Its files are three handoff notes under handoffs/local-move/. The coordinator note says "The owner moves it from cloud to a local session" and lists a ruling "pause when possible, then take the build local. Process only." That reads as a one-way move; it does not say "for now" or "both". It changes no rule, code or setting. If it merges, main holds handoff notes that say the build moved to local. So its text is stronger than your words. Nothing is closed or touched. Options: fix the wording to "moving local for now; always both", or drop the draft. Tell me which, in a line, and runner 11 does it.

shown.label: Done: home builds already run local
Dropped: I no longer want home builds local

title: Home #684 records your Nov 11 wish to take home builds local: is the local move done, dropped, or still wanted?
why: Only you know whether the wish still stands.
